channel.title: Dong Xing's Blog
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Dong Xing's Blog

item.title: Knuth-Morris-Pratt Automaton
item.description: The Knuth-Morris-Pratt Automaton is a data structure that maintains a string s in \Sigma^* by maintaining a deterministic finite automaton that accepts and only accepts strings containing s as a suffix.

item.title: Bubble Sort
item.description: Bubble Sort is an algorithm that sorts an array of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n^2) time and \mathcal{O}(1) space.

item.title: Counting Sort
item.description: Counting Sort is an algorithm that sorts an array of n integers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1}\in\{0,1,\dots,m-1\} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n+m) time and \mathcal{O}(m) space.

item.title: Fast Mobius Transform
item.description: The Fast Mobius Transform is an algorithm that computes f(S)=\sum_{T\subseteq S}g(T) for a function g defined on 2^{\{0,1,\dots,n-1\}} in \mathcal{O}(n2^n) time and \mathcal{O}(1) space.

item.title: Heapsort
item.description: Heapsort is an algorithm that sorts an array of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(1) space.

item.title: Insertion Sort
item.description: Insertion Sort is an algorithm that sorts an array of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n^2) time and \mathcal{O}(1) space.

item.title: Kasai's Algorithm
item.description: Kasai’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes h(0),h(1),\dots,h(n-2) for a string of length n, where h(i)=\left|\operatorname{lcp}\{s_{a_i}s_{a_i+1}\dots s_{n-1},s_{a_{i+1}}s_{a_{i+1}+1}\dots s_{n-1}\}\right| where a_i denotes the starting index of the i-th lexicographically smallest suffix of s, ...

item.title: Manber-Myers Algorithm
item.description: The Manber-Myers Algorithm is an algorithm that finds the lexicographical order of the suffixes of a string s of length n in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Merge Sort
item.description: Merge Sort is an algorithm that sorts an array of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Quicksort
item.description: Quicksort is an algorithm that sorts an array of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(\log n) space.
